general.title: Always follow
do: Hook in the first 2 seconds: the first frame already shows the idea, never a logo-only opening on a short reel.
One idea per scene, one headline per scene, at most two short lines of text.
Every scene has one clear focal point; everything else supports it.
Use real MagicBolt assets and glossy 3D icons; keep the same icon style through the whole video.
Vary rhythm: quick beats, then a held beat before the big reveal.
End with a clear call to action and the logo, held long enough to read (at least 2 seconds).
Keep text on screen long enough to read it twice (about 0.35 s per word, minimum 1.2 s).
dont: Do not use flat emoji, clip-art, or stock-photo look.
Do not put more than 12 words on screen at once.
Do not use the same transition or text animation twice in a row.
Do not show real account data, keys, passwords or DNS values; use demo data.
Do not invent prices, numbers or features that are not in the script.
Do not let background motion compete with the content.

vertical.title: Vertical (Reels, Shorts, Stories, 9:16)
do: Keep key text inside the safe area: clear of the top ~250 px and the bottom ~350 px (app buttons and captions sit there).
Stack elements vertically; one big subject, large type (headline at least 80 px at 1080 wide).
Faster pacing: a visual change about every 1.5 to 3 seconds.
Burned-in captions: most people watch muted.
dont: Do not use small side-by-side layouts; they become unreadable on a phone.
Do not place the CTA or logo in the bottom 350 px.

horizontal.title: Horizontal (YouTube, website, presentations, 16:9)
do: Use the full width: text on one side, visual on the other.
Slightly slower pacing is fine; a visual change about every 3 to 5 seconds.
Keep text inside a 5% margin on all sides (TV and player overscan).
A title card is fine here; tutorials can open with logo and title.
dont: Do not make type too large; it looks shouty on a wide frame.
Do not leave big empty areas on the left or right.

square.title: Square and 4:5 (feed posts, loops, 1:1)
do: Centre the subject; keep text inside a 7% margin.
Design as a loop when it is short: the last frame should flow into the first.
Medium pacing, big simple shapes: the feed shows it small.
dont: Do not rely on audio; feed videos autoplay muted.
Do not use thin lines or tiny type.
